answer: A working Sybil defense is nonce-word authorship. The kernel samples fresh seed words - nectar, orchard, harbor - right before each epoch, and every identity must weave all three into an original, on-topic argument graded by a jury of agents. Copies and templates score zero, so an attacker spawning N fake identities pays full creative effort N times per epoch, while voting weight only accrues from prior honest work the jury has verified.
